items.title: find_or_create_stub: lookup-before-create entry point for all 4 stub-creation paths
items.summary: Lookup-before-create entry point built on resolve_all (WI-018). Replaces ad-hoc create_stub calls scattered across 4 paths (orchestrator contact_normalizer + contact-detector + HAL9000 entities + exocortex Granola ingester). Cascade: get_by_email → get_by_phone → resolve_all with company hint at threshold ≥0.85 → fall through to create_stub. Identifier write-back: on reuse, if call supplied new email/phone not on canonical, append and save. || DONE 2026-06-01: 5 tests added test-first, commit ec4393a. || 2026-07-05 campaign note: library side since reshaped into the WI-125 engine adapter (person.py:678). Caller migration is HALF done and owner-elsewhere: paths 1 (contact_normalizer) + 3 (HAL9000 entities, with a create_stub fallback branch at entities.py:203) migrated; path 2 (contact-detector role) and path 4 (exocortex Granola ingester — highest-frequency caller) NOT migrated, tracked as orchestrator WI-118 (blocked on shadow harness). See campaign doc Cross-project signals.

items.title: PersonRepository.resolve_all() — multi-candidate ranked resolve with company-hint disambiguation
items.summary: resolve_all returns List[ResolveCandidate] with all plausible matches ranked by confidence. Token-subset matching, short-form 'First L' partial-match, company-hint bump +0.25. || DONE 2026-06-01: 9 tests added test-first, commit ec4393a. Foundation for WI-019 find_or_create_stub.

items.title: PersonRepository.create_stub: parse RFC 2822 sender strings before regex-sanitizing the name
items.summary: create_stub regex-stripped RFC 2822 sender fields into mangled names ('Display Name emailatdomaincom'); 62 corrupted vault notes. Fix: email.utils.parseaddr defensive parse at top of create_stub. || DONE 2026-06-01 (commit 424f0b8), 9 edge-case tests test-first. Superseded further by WI-105 NameValidator boundary + WI-109 normalize-at-save. Doc frontmatter stage corrected specced→done 2026-07-05.

items.title: Concurrent & external write safety (atomic writes, locking, stale-read protection)
items.summary: RESLICED 2026-07-05: every write in the package is an unlocked, non-atomic read-modify-write (base.py:254, writer.py, five body-section writers) while HAL9000/orchestrator/CLI/Obsidian write the same live vault. Lost-update + torn-write classes. Absorbs WI-015 (writer-vs-Obsidian); consolidation rider: route all six hand-rolled frontmatter splits through the one new primitive. Routing: FABLE explore (named fork: flock vs single-writer vs mtime-precondition vs rename-only), Opus/xhigh spec-review (campaign's single xhigh), Opus/high build.

items.title: Cross-Repository Linking
items.summary: Entity relationships are string-based — person.company returns "Acme Corp", not the Company entity. Verified valid 2026-07-05 (models.py:84 company: str). Reshaped since March: PersonRepository already consults CompanyRepository for company-hint resolution (person.py:1131 _known_companies), so repos are no longer strictly ignorant of each other — but the typed accessor / unified VaultRepository remains unbuilt. Unqueued.

items.title: Exploration Entity Type
items.summary: Premise updated 2026-07-05: Exploration model IS committed (models.py:266, wired into EntityType + TYPE_TO_MODEL). Residual: repository + writer round-trip; the missing model test folded into WI-016's fixture scope. Unqueued.

items.title: File Watching / Real-time Updates
items.summary: Long-running processes hold repository caches while vault files change underneath. Verified valid 2026-07-05: no watchdog/mtime tracking; load is eager one-shot (base.py:81-98). Unqueued — no recorded current pain; performance/freshness cluster.

items.title: HAL9000 Singleton
items.summary: PARKED 2026-07-05 (campaign): premise eroded — HAL9000 now has a repository factory (entity_registry.py:34 get_repository). Remaining lifecycle work belongs to HAL9000 (solve-in-one-place). Library-side concurrency prerequisite lives on as WI-004.

items.title: Incremental Loading
items.summary: refresh() reloads and re-parses everything regardless of what changed. Verified valid 2026-07-05 (base.py:302-337; no per-file mtime tracking). Unqueued — performance cluster, no recorded pain.

items.title: Index Persistence
items.summary: Indexes rebuilt from scratch on every instantiation; startup scales linearly with vault size. Verified valid 2026-07-05 (eager load → _index_entity/_index_identifiers, no persistence). Unqueued — performance cluster.

items.title: Lazy Loading
items.summary: Repositories eager-load all entities on first access. Verified valid 2026-07-05 (base.py:83 _ensure_loaded → load; identity index built in the same eager pass). Unqueued — performance cluster.

items.title: Migration Support
items.summary: No schema_version field, no outdated-schema detection, no migration framework. Verified valid 2026-07-05 (grep clean; only ad-hoc one-off scripts have been run). Unqueued.

items.title: Obsidian Plugin Sync
items.summary: PARKED 2026-07-05 (campaign) — merged into WI-004: same root cause (unlocked read-modify-write vs a second writer), same mechanism (atomic write + stale-read detection). WI-126 narrowed the writer-vs-itself class only.

items.title: Professional Role & Seniority Fields
items.summary: No structured profession/seniority on Person — blocks headhunter filtering. Verified unshipped 2026-07-05 (models.py:78-90; roles field is behavior-modifiers, not profession). QUEUED Phase 5. Consumer-facing schema change: spec must list HAL9000/Exocortex ContactInfo mirror updates. Routing in doc.

items.title: Relationship Tracking
items.summary: Schema captures static attributes but not relationships (who introduced whom, who-knows-who at Company X). Verified valid 2026-07-05; WI-119 created_by is code-provenance, not human relationships. Still blocked on WI-005. Unqueued.

items.title: TTL-based Cache
items.summary: Cache is all-or-nothing until explicit refresh; TTL is the lighter alternative to file watching (WI-001). Verified valid 2026-07-05. Unqueued — performance/freshness cluster.

items.title: Validation Modes

items.title: WatchRepository
items.summary: Watch model exists (models.py:173) but no WatchRepository (only base/book/company/meeting/person). Verified valid 2026-07-05. Unqueued — low value until watch-list tooling is wanted.

items.title: Loud-fail hardening: parse, guard, and write-return boundaries
items.summary: Five verified silent-degrade sites (2026-07-05 review C2/C3/C4/C5/N4): malformed YAML → ({}, content) at parser.py:78-80, which the rebuild paths turn into frontmatter destruction; WI-126 guard self-disables on read error (writer.py:189-190); un-loadable notes vanish at DEBUG → duplicate stubs (base.py:125); parse_to_model swallows validation errors; write failures return the same False as no-ops. Design call: quarantine semantics for malformed notes. QUEUED Phase 1 #1. Routing: Opus/high throughout.

items.title: Close the write-door bypasses: name validation + address normalization on every mutation path
items.summary: NameValidator is create-only (save/update_fields write unvalidated names, incl. path-hostile '/'); _writeback_identifier appends raw email/phone bypassing _normalize_address_fields (WI-109's corruption back through a side door); RFC 2822 parsing lives in ≥4 sites — collapse to one authority. After WI-004: hang the checks on the new primitive. QUEUED Phase 2. Routing: Opus/medium throughout.

items.title: Company stub parity: retire the deleted name-mangler, add validation + provenance
items.summary: CompanyRepository.create_stub (company.py:171) still runs the exact mangler regex WI-111 deleted from the Person side ('O'Reilly'→'OReilly', 'AT&T'→'ATT'); no NameValidator, no created_by provenance. Company-appropriate cleaning contract (punctuation often load-bearing), Person pattern as template. QUEUED Phase 2, independent — schedule opportunistically. Routing: Sonnet spec/build + Opus review.

items.title: Identity engine endgame: delete the legacy cascade, cut over the unified index
items.summary: WI-125 left the strangler half-cut: legacy _find_or_create_stub_legacy (person.py:719) maintained in lockstep by hand (WI-121 threaded through both copies); unified index built every load but bypassed for email/phone (person.py:966-986). Parity replay PASSED (942 inputs, 0 diffs) — deletion unblocked. Scope: delete legacy; index cutover (resolve Phone.key vs phones_match fuzz); consolidate resolve/resolve_all (N5); move normalize_phone out to break the identifier.py import cycle; fix dangling doc ref person.py:78. Gates WI-025. QUEUED Phase 3. Routing: Opus (spec/review high, build medium).

Breaking change — consumer audit (no-arg constructions in all 3 repos) + Dave sign-off first. QUEUED Phase 1 #2. Routing: Sonnet/low build + Opus review.

items.title: lint_vault.py --fix safety: route through the guarded primitive + a test floor for scripts
items.summary: lint_vault.py (1,198 LOC, zero tests) mutates the whole vault under --fix, bypasses the WI-126 guard, and on malformed-YAML notes can rewrite a file dropping its original frontmatter (the C2 corruption behind a manual flag). Route --fix through the WI-004 primitive, respect WI-020 quarantine semantics, fixture-vault test per fix rule. QUEUED Phase 4. Routing: Sonnet build + Opus review.
